patterns.note: Asymmetrical content blocks often pair images and text, with one element sometimes spanning wider or acting as a full-bleed background.
Oversized, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, creating a strong visual hierarchy and impactful statements.
High-contrast color blocking is a dominant theme, primarily using black, white, and a vibrant lime green (#d9fd21) to define sections and highlight key information.
The navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay on the hero video to a solid, high-contrast lime green sticky bar with black text as the user scrolls down the page.
Full-bleed, single-color background sections (especially lime green) are used to punctuate content flow and create visual breaks.

technique_notes: A full-width video plays as the hero background, which scrolls out of view to reveal the main page content. This uses the detected video-hero technique.

The primary navigation bar dynamically changes its appearance from transparent to a solid, high-contrast background color (lime green) and sticks to the top of the viewport after the initial hero section scrolls past.
Content sections are revealed sequentially as the user scrolls down the page, appearing from the bottom of the viewport without complex fade-ins or slides.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, uppercase-capable headings (up to ~4-5x body text size) are paired with smaller, regular-weight body text for high contrast and impact.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners universally applied to all elements, including buttons and image frames.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and moderate padding within content blocks.

standout: The aggressive and consistent use of a high-contrast black and vibrant lime green color palette, combined with oversized, bold sans-serif typography, creates an energetic and almost brutalist aesthetic that is highly distinctive.
